conditions.scope: Explicit standalone jem sandbox only, integrated singleplayer owner; no dedicated server or canonical pack installation.

change.summary: Replace sandbox main-skill VFX with native Blockbench models, using V to execute source-derived race signatures with unlimited selection and no cooldowns.

modifiers.before: Standalone has demo galleries and F9 Bloom R3; no actual signature keybind or free server-owned race selection.
modifiers.after: F6 selects any race repeatedly, V executes tier-3 signatures on the integrated server and emits only Blockbench replacement models. Ancestors shield R7, Void R6, Bloom coffer R4, Sculk crawl R4, Nether R6. No selection lock/cooldown; target and safe-teleport prerequisites retained. Infernal damage synchronized to authored impacts at ticks4/10/16. All authored sources bundled.

rationale.purpose: Use new Blockbench art as the actual main-skill output in the requested sandbox rather than an unrelated gallery.
rationale.decision_source: User requested a sandbox mod with actual keybinds, repeatable race switching, no cooldowns and all Blockbench work, then explicitly corrected that these effects must replace old VFX as main skills. Codex chose a source-derived standalone adapter to canonical JEMRoles signature methods, server-owned selection/casts, native OBJ animation exports and a bundled editable archive.

introduced.summary: Sandbox-only replacement main-skill integration, all editable work archived.

history.summary: Sandbox-only replacement main-skill integration, all editable work archived.

notes: No production JEMRoles source or canonical Server/Client/ManagedPack artifact changes. Native AutoModpack publication unchanged.

The sandbox build extracts signature mechanics from canonical JEMRoles source; no independently maintained copy of production gameplay rules. Tier3, no account/selection/cooldown gates, and native-clip impact synchronization are explicit sandbox differences.
Existing F8 gallery remains historical evidence; the main V key never emits old particle VFX.
